description: Start chasing an unpaid invoice: register the client, the invoice reference, the amount in integer cents, the currency and the due date, and get the three-letter escalation schedule (reminder 1, reminder 2, final notice) with the date each falls due. Free tier: 3 unpaid invoices chased at once.

amount_minor.description: The invoice amount in whole minor units (integer cents). 125000 is USD 1,250.00

client.description: Who owes the money, e.g. Acme Ltd

currency.description: ISO code the invoice was issued in

due.description: The date payment fell due, YYYY-MM-DD. The ladder is anchored to this date

duplicate_ok.description: Register even though an identical invoice is already on the register. Default false

gaps.description: Days after the due date at which reminder 1, reminder 2 and the final notice fall due, strictly increasing. Default [7, 14, 21]

issued.description: The date the invoice was issued, YYYY-MM-DD, for the letter's reference line

late_fee_percent_per_month.description: Late payment interest your terms allow, percent per month, simple and pro-rata. When set, reminder 2 and the final notice state the accrued figure

reference.description: The invoice number being chased, e.g. INV-1042

name: invoice_register
title: Register an unpaid invoice to chase
